label: lem:frobenius-cocasimir-refuted-deuteron
title: Frobenius co-Casimir $\Delta_\lambda$ ansatz refuted at the deuteron
html:
The Frobenius co-Casimir prescription \Delta_\lambda = 1/\dim_q(\lambda) fails to close the binding energy formula for the deuteron.

The signed binding density yields +0.145 m_e, missing the target -4.35 m_e. The gap exceeds the tolerance. The sign is incorrect.

This algebraic refutation eliminates the co-Casimir ansatz as a universal correction factor. No rescaling was applied to \Delta_\lambda.
